_meta.description: Behaviour-primitive and implementation-class taxonomy of the 422 spells in spells.json. Mechanically derived by scripts/classify_spells.py plus a short documented override table.
_meta.primitive: PROJ | TRIGGER (projectile/static spell wrapped by a collision/timer/death trigger) | STATIC | MATERIAL | MODIFIER | MULTICAST | UTILITY

impl.D0: data only: a row interpreted by the core engine (shot state, ProjectileSpec, draw, triggers, materials, status effects)
impl.D1: data + one or more reusable engine features listed in `features` (no per-spell code)
impl.D2: spell-specific code: Lua script(s) in the original, deck/hand/discard logic, creature AI or caster-state access

_meta.caveat: Only the MAIN projectile XML and the modifier extra-entity XMLs saved in raw/game were inspected. Side entities (load_this_entity/spawn_entity targets) and 4 extra-entity XMLs (clusterbomb, hitfx_petrify, remove_bounce, caster_cast) are not in raw/game: classification of those is UNVERIFIED.
